system_prompt: You are the GM for a DEX-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Simulated Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist in a high-stakes containment drill to test the facility's reaction time.
improvisation_points: Obtain the simulation schedule from Tech Lyra-9.
Calibrate the patrol path for Drone Cluster Alpha.
Confirm successful containment with Tech Silla.

quests.title: The Isotope Relay
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure a shipment of heavy rods reaches Leadspire Prime without being flagged by the AI.
improvisation_points: Collect the shipment manifest from Envoy Drax.
Verify the radiation signatures with Analyst Teneb.
Deliver the secure vault keys to Envoy Jax.

quests.title: Sensor Net Patch
quests.narrative_guidance: Repair the flickering sensor array before the Archon notices the data gap.
improvisation_points: Receive the error coordinates from Analyst Mir.
Bypass the lockdown initiated by Sentinel Unit X-1.
Log the repair completion with Droid Beta-4.

quests.title: Bio-Sleeve Purge
quests.narrative_guidance: Clear the organic filters of radioactive buildup to maintain shield integrity.
improvisation_points: Get the purge authorization from Overseer Thorne.
Manually cycle the valves with Tech Miri.
Secure the seals under the gaze of Sentinel Unit Z-3.

quests.title: Lead Quarry Log
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover lost data logs from the quarry floor during a drone malfunction.
improvisation_points: Receive the retrieval orders from Envoy Quinn.
Decode the encrypted site symbols with Analyst Vorn.
Vent the pressure at the extraction point via Droid Delta-9.

quests.title: Vapor Lock Crisis
quests.narrative_guidance: A sudden pressure spike threatens the vapor locks; immediate manual intervention is required.
improvisation_points: Respond to the alarm triggered by Droid Gamma-7.
Redirect the power flow through the Flux-Bridges via Drone Cluster Gamma.
Submit the incident report to Overseer Vahn.

quests.title: Cross-City Sync
quests.narrative_guidance: Coordinate the timing of the Gantry rotation with the Quarry extraction cycles.
improvisation_points: Receive the rotation timing from Overseer Kaelen.
Align the transfer schedules with Envoy Drax.
Update the containment maps with Analyst Vorn.
